content.text: {"cards":[{"id":"stamped_electrum","year":-610,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Lydia"},"title":"Lumps With a Lion","description":"Your goldsmiths propose stamping electrum from the Pactolus with a lion's head, so merchants trust the weight without a scale.","options":[{"label":"Strike royal stamped coins","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-60},{"key":"techPoints","value":30},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]},{"label":"Keep weighing metal by the scale","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":40},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-10}]}],"he":{"title":"גושים עם אריה","description":"הצורפים שלך מציעים להטביע ראש אריה על האלקטרום מנהר פקטולוס, כדי שסוחרים יסמכו על המשקל בלי מאזניים.","options":["הטבע מטבעות מלכותיים חתומים","המשך לשקול מתכת במאזניים"]}},{"id":"cimmerian_riders","year":-696,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Midas"},"title":"Riders From the North","description":"Cimmerian horsemen pour across the Halys and ride toward Gordion, burning villages as they come.","options":[{"label":"Pay the riders to pass by","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-120},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]},{"label":"Man the citadel walls","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-40},{"key":"defenseBonus","value":0.1}]}],"he":{"title":"פרשים מן הצפון","description":"פרשים קימרים חוצים את נהר האליס ודוהרים לעבר גורדיון, ושורפים כפרים בדרכם.","options":["שלם לפרשים כדי שיעברו הלאה","אייש את חומות המצודה"]}},{"id":"erebuni_captives","year":-782,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Argishti"},"title":"A Fortress at Erebuni","description":"You have raised a new fortress on the Ararat plain, and thousands of captives from your campaigns await your word.","options":[{"label":"Settle the captives around the fortress","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-50},{"key":"defenseBonus","value":0.1},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":5}]},{"label":"Return them to their valleys","effects":[{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":20},{"key":"gold","value":-30}]}],"he":{"title":"מבצר בארבוני","description":"הקמת מבצר חדש במישור אררט, ואלפי שבויים ממסעותיך ממתינים להחלטתך.","options":["יישב את השבויים סביב המבצר","החזר אותם לעמקיהם"]}},{"id":"median_army_reform","year":-615,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Cyaxares"},"title":"Spears, Bows and Horses","description":"Your levies fight as mixed clan bands. Your officers urge you to split them into separate units of spearmen, archers and cavalry before marching on Assyria.","options":[{"label":"Divide the army by arms","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-100},{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":50}]},{"label":"Keep the clan war bands","effects":[{"key":"controlBonus","value":5},{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":-10}]}],"he":{"title":"חניתות, קשתות וסוסים","description":"גייסותיך נלחמים כלהקות שבטיות מעורבות. קציניך מפצירים בך לחלק אותם ליחידות נפרדות של נושאי חנית, קשתים ופרשים לפני המסע על אשור.","options":["חלק את הצבא לפי סוגי נשק","השאר את להקות השבטים"]}},{"id":"marib_sluices","year":-700,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Maryab"},"title":"The Great Dam Cracks","description":"Floods in the Wadi Dhana have scoured the dam's sluices. Without repair, the fields of the two oases will go dry.","options":[{"label":"Rebuild the sluices in cut stone","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-150},{"key":"hr","value":-30},{"key":"controlBonus","value":10}]},{"label":"Patch it with earth and hope","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-20},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":5}]}],"he":{"title":"הסכר הגדול נסדק","description":"שיטפונות בוואדי דאנה כרסמו את פתחי הסכר. בלי תיקון, שדות שני הנאות יתייבשו.","options":["בנה מחדש את הפתחים באבן מסותתת","טלא בעפר וקווה לטוב"]}},{"id":"tribute_to_assyria","year":-738,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Zabibe"},"title":"The Assyrian Demand","description":"Tiglath-Pileser's army stands in Syria, and his envoys demand camels and tribute from the queen of the Arabs.","options":[{"label":"Send camels and gold","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-100},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":25}]},{"label":"Withdraw deep into the desert","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-20},{"key":"defenseBonus","value":0.05},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-15}]}],"he":{"title":"הדרישה האשורית","description":"צבאו של תגלת פלאסר עומד בסוריה, ושליחיו דורשים גמלים ומס ממלכת הערבים.","options":["שלחי גמלים וזהב","היסוגי אל עומק המדבר"]}},{"id":"roman_annexation","year":106,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Hegra"},"title":"Rome Takes Arabia","description":"Trajan has annexed the Nabataean kingdom, and a Roman detachment marches south to garrison Hegra and its caravan road.","options":[{"label":"Open the gates to the garrison","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":60},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":10}]},{"label":"Shelter Nabataean loyalists","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-30},{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":20},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-20}]}],"he":{"title":"רומא כובשת את ערב","description":"טריאנוס סיפח את הממלכה הנבטית, ויחידה רומית צועדת דרומה להציב חיל מצב בחגרה ובדרך השיירות שלה.","options":["פתח את השערים לחיל המצב","הסתר את נאמני הנבטים"]}},{"id":"asiatic_vespers","year":-88,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Mithridates"},"title":"Letters to Every City","description":"Your armies hold Asia. Your advisors propose secret orders to the cities to fall on every Roman and Italian on the same day.","options":[{"label":"Send the orders to kill","effects":[{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":40},{"key":"controlBonus","value":10},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-40}]},{"label":"Seize their goods, spare their lives","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":120},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":5}]}],"he":{"title":"מכתבים לכל עיר","description":"צבאותיך שולטים באסיה. יועציך מציעים פקודות סודיות לערים להתנפל על כל רומאי ואיטלקי ביום אחד.","options":["שלח את פקודות ההריגה","החרם את רכושם וחוס על חייהם"]}}]}

{"cards":[{"id":"looted_terracottas","year":1998,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Nok"},"title":"Terracottas on Foreign Markets","description":"Diggers are stripping ancient Nok sites at night, and the clay heads turn up in European auction houses. Your village elders demand action.","options":[{"label":"Post armed guards at the sites","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-100},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]},{"label":"Press foreign museums for return","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-50},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":30}]},{"label":"Sell legal export permits","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":120},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":6}]}],"he":{"title":"פסלי טרקוטה בשווקים זרים","description":"חופרים בוזזים בלילות את אתרי נוק העתיקים, וראשי החימר מופיעים בבתי מכירות פומביות באירופה. זקני הכפרים דורשים ממך לפעול.","options":["הצב שומרים חמושים באתרים","לחץ על מוזיאונים זרים להחזיר","מכור היתרי ייצוא חוקיים"]}},{"id":"gsm_licences","year":2001,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Ayo"},"title":"The Mobile Phone Licences","description":"Telecom giants bid for the right to build mobile networks, Ayo. A high price fills the treasury, but cheap licences could put a phone in every market.","options":[{"label":"Auction to the highest bidder","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":200},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":5}]},{"label":"Grant cheap licences for wide coverage","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-50},{"key":"techPoints","value":60}]}],"he":{"title":"רישיונות הטלפון הנייד","description":"ענקיות תקשורת מתחרות על הזכות לבנות רשתות סלולריות, איו. מחיר גבוה ימלא את האוצר, אבל רישיונות זולים יביאו טלפון לכל שוק.","options":["מכור במכרז למציע הגבוה","העניק רישיונות זולים לכיסוי רחב"]}},{"id":"home_video_boom","year":1992,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Ile-Ife"},"title":"The Home Video Boom","description":"Cheap cameras and video cassettes have turned Ile-Ife's actors into stars, but pirated copies sell faster than the originals.","options":[{"label":"Fund local studios","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-80},{"key":"techPoints","value":20},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]},{"label":"Raid the pirate markets","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-60},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":4},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":10}]},{"label":"Tax the trade and look away","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":70},{"key":"techPoints","value":-10}]}],"he":{"title":"פריחת הווידאו הביתי","description":"מצלמות זולות וקלטות וידאו הפכו את שחקני אילה-איפה לכוכבים, אבל עותקים פיראטיים נמכרים מהר יותר מהמקור.","options":["ממן אולפנים מקומיים","פשוט על שווקי הפיראטים","מסה את הסחר והעלם עין"]}},{"id":"offshore_oil_find","year":2007,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Bono Manso"},"title":"Oil Beneath the Sea","description":"Drillers strike a large oil field off the coast, and Bono Manso fills with consultants. How fast you pump will shape a generation.","options":[{"label":"Pump as fast as possible","effects":[{"key":"oil","value":200},{"key":"gold","value":100},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":8}]},{"label":"Pass a law to save revenues","effects":[{"key":"oil","value":80},{"key":"gold","value":-40},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":20}]}],"he":{"title":"נפט מתחת לים","description":"קודחים מגלים שדה נפט גדול מול החוף, ובונו מאנסו מתמלאת ביועצים. קצב השאיבה שלך יעצב דור שלם.","options":["שאב מהר ככל האפשר","חוקק חוק לחיסכון בהכנסות"]}},{"id":"cobalt_rush","year":2008,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Kabongo"},"title":"The Cobalt Rush","description":"The world's phones and batteries need cobalt, and diggers with shovels crowd the pits near Kabongo. Foreign companies offer to take over.","options":[{"label":"Sell concessions to foreign miners","effects":[{"key":"copper","value":150},{"key":"gold","value":150},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":10}]},{"label":"Organize the diggers into cooperatives","effects":[{"key":"copper","value":60},{"key":"gold","value":-80},{"key":"controlBonus","value":6}]}],"he":{"title":"הבהלה לקובלט","description":"הטלפונים והסוללות של העולם זקוקים לקובלט, וחופרים עם אתים צובאים על הבורות ליד קבונגו. חברות זרות מציעות להשתלט.","options":["מכור זיכיונות לכורים זרים","ארגן את החופרים בקואופרטיבים"]}},{"id":"diamond_certification","year":2003,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Lunda"},"title":"Certifying the Diamonds","description":"A new international scheme demands that every rough diamond carry a certificate of origin. Lunda diggers have long sold theirs across the border.","options":[{"label":"Join the certification scheme","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-80},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":40}]},{"label":"Quietly tolerate the smugglers","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":150},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":8},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-20}]}],"he":{"title":"אישור היהלומים","description":"מנגנון בינלאומי חדש דורש שכל יהלום גולמי יישא תעודת מקור. חופרי הלונדה מכרו את שלהם מעבר לגבול מזה זמן רב.","options":["הצטרף למנגנון האישור","השלם בשקט עם המבריחים"]}},{"id":"ebola_outbreak","year":2018,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Lueji"},"title":"Ebola Returns","description":"Ebola breaks out in the eastern provinces, Lueji. A new vaccine exists, but health teams face distrust and armed groups on the roads.","options":[{"label":"Send vaccination teams with escorts","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-150},{"key":"techPoints","value":20},{"key":"hr","value":-30}]},{"label":"Seal the roads out of the region","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-40},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":6}]}],"he":{"title":"האבולה חוזרת","description":"אבולה פורצת במחוזות המזרחיים, לואג'י. קיים חיסון חדש, אבל צוותי הבריאות נתקלים בחוסר אמון ובקבוצות חמושות בדרכים.","options":["שלח צוותי חיסון עם ליווי","חסום את הדרכים היוצאות מהאזור"]}},{"id":"ceasefire_demobilization","year":2002,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Ngola Kiluanje"},"title":"After the Ceasefire","description":"The long civil war is over, Ngola Kiluanje, and tens of thousands of rebel fighters wait in camps. Each one needs a future.","options":[{"label":"Absorb them into the army","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":100},{"key":"gold","value":-150}]},{"label":"Pay them to go home","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-200},{"key":"controlBonus","value":10}]},{"label":"Disband the camps without pay","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":50},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":12}]}],"he":{"title":"אחרי הפסקת האש","description":"מלחמת האזרחים הארוכה הסתיימה, נגולה קילואנז'ה, ועשרות אלפי לוחמי מורדים ממתינים במחנות. כל אחד מהם זקוק לעתיד.","options":["שלב אותם בצבא","שלם להם כדי שישובו הביתה","פרק את המחנות ללא תשלום"]}}]}

{"cards":[{"id":"siege_of_candia","year":1648,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Knossos"},"title":"The Long Siege","description":"Ottoman armies have landed on Crete and dug trenches before the great walled port near Knossos. Engineers beg for powder and stone; merchants beg for peace.","options":[{"label":"Pour silver into the bastions","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-150},{"key":"defenseBonus","value":0.12}]},{"label":"Seek terms from the Sultan","effects":[{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":30},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":8}]}],"he":{"title":"המצור הארוך","description":"צבאות עות'מאניים נחתו בכרתים וחפרו תעלות מול נמל החומות הגדול שליד קנוסוס. המהנדסים מתחננים לאבק שריפה ואבן, והסוחרים מתחננים לשלום.","options":["השקע כסף במבצרים","בקש תנאים מהסולטן"]}},{"id":"iron_mountain_union","year":1625,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Noreia"},"title":"The Iron Mountain Guilds","description":"The quarrelling ironmasters of the Styrian ore mountain near Noreia are going bankrupt. Your treasurers propose merging them into one crown-backed company.","options":[{"label":"Merge them under crown oversight","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-100},{"key":"iron","value":120}]},{"label":"Let the old guilds compete","effects":[{"key":"iron","value":40},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":4}]}],"he":{"title":"גילדות הר הברזל","description":"אדוני הברזל המסוכסכים בהר העפרות השטירי שליד נוריאה פושטים רגל. הגזברים שלך מציעים לאחד אותם לחברה אחת בגיבוי הכתר.","options":["אחד אותם בפיקוח הכתר","תן לגילדות הוותיקות להתחרות"]}},{"id":"bursting_bottles","year":1729,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Durocortorum"},"title":"Wine That Bursts","description":"Cellars around Durocortorum now sell wine that foams in the glass, but many bottles explode in the heat. Glassmakers promise thicker bottles at a high price.","options":[{"label":"Fund stronger glassworks","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-80},{"key":"techPoints","value":25}]},{"label":"Tax the foaming wine trade","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":70},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":3}]}],"he":{"title":"יין שמתפוצץ","description":"המרתפים סביב דורוקורטורום מוכרים כעת יין שמקציף בכוס, אך בקבוקים רבים מתפוצצים בחום. יצרני הזכוכית מבטיחים בקבוקים עבים יותר במחיר גבוה.","options":["ממן מפעלי זכוכית חזקים יותר","הטל מס על סחר היין המקציף"]}},{"id":"portuguese_succession","year":1580,"subject":{"kind":"ruler","name":"Viriathus"},"title":"A Crown Without Heir","description":"The old king has died childless, and the King of Spain claims the throne with gold and soldiers. A royal bastard rallies the commons against him.","options":[{"label":"Accept the Spanish crown","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":120},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":10}]},{"label":"Back the pretender's army","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-90},{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":8},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]}],"he":{"title":"כתר ללא יורש","description":"המלך הזקן מת ללא ילדים, ומלך ספרד תובע את הכס בזהב ובחיילים. בן לא חוקי של בית המלוכה מלכד את פשוטי העם נגדו.","options":["קבל את הכתר הספרדי","תמוך בצבא הטוען לכתר"]}},{"id":"allied_fleet_kerch","year":1855,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Panticapaeum"},"title":"Fleets in the Strait","description":"British and French warships are heading for the strait at Panticapaeum to cut supplies to the besieged Crimean fortress. The garrison cannot hold everything.","options":[{"label":"Burn the depots and withdraw","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-60},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":6}]},{"label":"Reinforce the shore batteries","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-80},{"key":"defenseBonus","value":0.1}]}],"he":{"title":"ציים במצר","description":"ספינות מלחמה בריטיות וצרפתיות עושות דרכן אל המצר שליד פנטיקפאיון כדי לנתק את האספקה למבצר הנצור בקרים. חיל המצב אינו יכול להחזיק בהכול.","options":["שרוף את המחסנים וסגת","תגבר את סוללות החוף"]}},{"id":"dutch_timber_trade","year":1620,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Rygir"},"title":"Dutch Ships for Timber","description":"Dutch skippers crowd the fjords of the Rygir, paying well for sawn planks and masts. Water-powered sawmills spread, and the forests thin quickly.","options":[{"label":"License the sawmills and tax them","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":110},{"key":"controlPenalty","value":4}]},{"label":"Reserve the oaks for your navy","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-40},{"key":"militaryStrengthBonus","value":6}]}],"he":{"title":"ספינות הולנדיות לעצים","description":"רבי חובלים הולנדים ממלאים את הפיורדים של הריגיר ומשלמים היטב על קורות מנוסרות ותרנים. מנסרות מונעות במים מתפשטות, והיערות מידלדלים במהירות.","options":["תן רישיון למנסרות והטל עליהן מס","שמור את האלונים לצי שלך"]}},{"id":"mountain_serf_revolt","year":1784,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Dacia"},"title":"The Miners Rise","description":"Serfs of the gold-mining mountains of Dacia have risen against their lords, burning manors and demanding freedom. The nobles demand troops; the peasants demand justice.","options":[{"label":"Crush the rising by force","effects":[{"key":"hr","value":-60},{"key":"controlBonus","value":8},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":-15}]},{"label":"Ease the labor dues","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-90},{"key":"controlBonus","value":5}]}],"he":{"title":"הכורים מתקוממים","description":"צמיתי הרי מכרות הזהב של דאקיה קמו נגד אדוניהם, שורפים אחוזות ודורשים חירות. האצילים דורשים חיילים, והאיכרים דורשים צדק.","options":["דכא את המרד בכוח","הקל על חובות העבודה"]}},{"id":"foreign_excavator","year":1876,"subject":{"kind":"city","name":"Mycenae"},"title":"A Rich Man Digs","description":"A wealthy German merchant asks to dig the shaft graves at Mycenae, promising golden treasures. Your archaeologists fear he will strip the site and boast abroad.","options":[{"label":"Grant the permit under supervision","effects":[{"key":"techPoints","value":35},{"key":"diplomacyPoints","value":15},{"key":"gold","value":-30}]},{"label":"Refuse and dig yourselves","effects":[{"key":"gold","value":-100},{"key":"techPoints","value":20}]}],"he":{"title":"עשיר אחד חופר","description":"סוחר גרמני עשיר מבקש לחפור את קברי הפיר במיקנה ומבטיח אוצרות זהב. הארכאולוגים שלך חוששים שיבזוז את האתר ויתרברב בחוץ לארץ.","options":["תן היתר תחת פיקוח","סרב וחפרו בעצמכם"]}}]}

{"cards":[{"id":"buddha_from_baekje","year":552,"subject":{"kind":"people","name":"Yamatai"},"title":"A Gilded Buddha Arrives","description":"Envoys from Baekje present a gilded statue and sutras, urging you to honor the foreign Buddha.
